Room = 30 (daily). Room for a new trade: 30. Status ok. Sizing part: risk amount 1% of 10,000 = 100 USD, EURUSD long, 20 pips, loss per lot 200 USD, rate 1. Budget cap 30 (daily) is below 100: risk budget 30, limited by daily. Raw lots: 30 / 200 = 0.15, exactly on a step. Lots 0.15. Actual risk: 30 USD = 0.3%. It equals the room exactly: if the stop is hit, equity ends at 9,500, on the daily floor. So the note loss-equals-room is added after the two cost notes. Notional: 0.15 x 108,500 = 16,275 USD.

cases.title: Room of 31: rounding down leaves the loss at 30, below the room, so no note
cases.working: Room part: Daily floor: 10,000 - 5% of 10,000 = 10,000 - 500 = 9,500. Daily room: 9,531 - 9,500 = 31. Total floor (static): 10,000 - 10% of 10,000 = 9,000. Total room: 531. Room = 31 (daily). Room for a new trade: 31. Status ok. Sizing part: risk amount 1% of 10,000 = 100 USD, EURUSD long, 20 pips, loss per lot 200 USD, rate 1. Budget cap 31 (daily) is below 100: risk budget 31, limited by daily. Raw lots: 31 / 200 = 0.155. Rounded down: 0.15. Actual risk: 30 USD = 0.3%, which is 1 USD below the room. There is no loss-equals-room note. Notional: 0.15 x 108,500 = 16,275 USD.

Equity 10,400 is above the high-water mark 10,000: note equity-above-high-water-mark in the room part. Sizing part: risk amount 1% of 10,000 = 100 USD, EURUSD long, 20 pips, loss per lot 200 USD, rate 1. Budget cap 1,400 (total) is above the risk amount 100: risk budget 100, limited by risk. Lots 0.50, actual risk 100 USD. The sizing notes are not changed by the room note.

cases.title: Balance typed with a thousands comma
cases.working: The balance '10,000' contains a comma. Any comma is rejected with code comma on the field balance. Everything else is valid.

cases.title: Entry price typed with a decimal comma
cases.working: The entry price '1,0850' contains a comma: code comma, field trade.entry.

cases.title: Balance left empty
cases.working: The balance is an empty string: code empty, field balance.

cases.title: Stop price is only spaces
cases.working: The stop price is three spaces. After trimming it is empty: code empty, field trade.stop.

cases.title: Negative balance
cases.working: The balance '-10000' parses as a number but must be above zero: code range, field balance.

cases.title: Stop equal to entry (written with a different number of zeros)
cases.working: Entry '1.0850' and stop '1.08500' are the same number. The stop must differ from the entry: code range, field trade.stop.

cases.title: EUR account, GBPUSD (a cross pair), conversion is null
cases.working: Quote currency USD differs from account currency EUR, and the symbol GBPUSD does not start with EURUSD, so a conversion is required. It is null: field conversion, code required.

cases.title: EUR account, GBPUSD (a cross pair), no conversion key at all
cases.working: Same as error-conversion-missing, but the conversion key is not present in the input: field conversion, code required.

cases.title: USD account, USD-quoted instrument, but a conversion is given
cases.working: Quote currency USD equals account currency USD, so the rate is 1 and a conversion must not be given: field conversion, code not-needed.

cases.title: EUR account trading GBPUSD, conversion pair given as GBPUSD
cases.working: The conversion pair must be made of exactly EUR and USD. GBPUSD has neither base = quote currency with quote = account currency, nor base = account currency with quote = quote currency: field conversion, code wrong-pair.

cases.title: USD account trading EURJPY, conversion given as EURJPY instead of USDJPY
cases.working: A common mistake: entering the traded pair as the conversion. Account USD, quote currency JPY: the pair must be USDJPY or JPYUSD. EURJPY is rejected: field conversion, code wrong-pair.

cases.title: Risk percent above 100
cases.working: Risk percent 100.01 is above the allowed maximum of 100: code range, field risk.value.

cases.title: Fixed risk amount larger than the balance
cases.working: Risk amount 600 is above the balance 500: code range, field risk.value.

cases.title: Risk of zero
cases.working: Risk percent 0 is not above zero: code range, field risk.value.

cases.title: Lot step of zero
cases.working: The lot step must be above zero: code range, field instrument.lotStep.

cases.title: Maximum lot below the minimum lot
cases.working: Maximum lot 0.005 is below the minimum lot 0.01: code range, field instrument.maxLot.

cases.title: Balance written as 1e4
cases.working: Exponent notation is not accepted: code format, field balance.

cases.title: Risk percent written as +1
cases.working: A leading plus sign is not accepted: code format, field risk.value.

cases.title: A 41 character number
cases.working: The balance is 10000 point and 35 zeros: 41 characters, one more than the limit of 40: code format, field balance. (The 40 character version is accepted, see input-number-formats.)

cases.title: Loss room with neither a daily nor a total rule
cases.working: Both daily and total are null. At least one rule is needed: field null, code no-rule.

cases.title: Loss room with equity of zero
cases.working: Current equity must be above zero: code range, field currentEquity.

cases.title: Loss room with open risk typed with a decimal comma
cases.working: Open risk '1,5' contains a comma: code comma, field openRisk.

cases.title: Loss room with a daily limit of 0 percent
cases.working: The daily limit percent must be above zero: code range, field daily.limitPercent.

cases.title: USD account trading USDJPY with base currency USD, but a conversion is also given
cases.working: The account currency is the instrument's base currency, so the instrument's own price is used and a conversion must not be given: field conversion, code not-needed.

cases.title: USD account trading USDJPY, no base currency, and a conversion is given
cases.working: No base currency is given, but the symbol USDJPY starts with the account currency USD followed by the quote currency JPY. That makes it an own-pair trade, so a conversion must not be given: field conversion, code not-needed. (A conversion price here would under-state the loss.)

cases.title: Own-pair long trade where the extra distance equals the stop price
cases.working: USD account, USDJPY long 150.00 to 145.00, base currency USD. Extra distance 145.00: exit price = 145.00 - 145.00 = 0. The exit price must be above zero: field trade.extraDistance, code range.

cases.title: Own-pair long trade where the extra distance is larger than the stop price
cases.working: USD account, USDJPY long 150.00 to 145.00, base currency USD. Extra distance 200: exit price = 145 - 200 = -55, below zero: field trade.extraDistance, code range.

cases.title: Base currency and quote currency are both JPY
cases.working: The base currency must differ from the quote currency: field instrument.baseCurrency, code range. The symbol EURJPY does not start with USDJPY, so the symbol check does not apply and this is the only fault. The rest of the input is valid (USD account, conversion USDJPY 150.00).

cases.title: USD account, symbol USDJPY, quote JPY, but base currency EUR is given
cases.working: The symbol USDJPY starts with the account currency USD followed by the quote currency JPY, so its base currency is USD. The given base currency is EUR, which contradicts the symbol: field instrument.baseCurrency, code conflict. The rest of the input is valid (conversion USDJPY 150.00).

cases.title: USD account, symbol 'usd/jpy', quote JPY, but base currency GBP is given
cases.working: The symbol usd/jpy is read in upper case without the slash: USDJPY. It starts with the account currency USD followed by the quote currency JPY. The given base currency GBP contradicts it: field instrument.baseCurrency, code conflict.

cases.title: Balance with an invisible U+FEFF character in front
cases.working: The balance is the character U+FEFF followed by 10000. Only space, tab, line feed and carriage return are ignored at the ends of a number. U+FEFF stays, and the text is then not a plain decimal number: field balance, code format.

cases.title: Entry price with a no-break space behind it
cases.working: The entry price is 1.08500 followed by a no-break space (U+00A0). A no-break space is not ignored, so the text is not a plain decimal number: field trade.entry, code format.

cases.title: Minimum lot 0.03 with lot step 0.02
cases.working: 0.03 / 0.02 = 1.5, which is not a whole number. The minimum lot must be a whole number of lot steps: field instrument.minLot, code not-on-step.

cases.title: Symbol is only spaces
cases.working: The symbol is three spaces. After trimming it is empty: field instrument.symbol, code empty.
